title: Drama around Bidadi township escalates as Union Minister Kumaraswamy ‘waits’ for Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar at Bairamangala for face-off
description: Kumaraswamy had invited Shivakumar for an ‘open discussion’ on the street of the Bairamangala, while the latter had invited the former to Vidhana Soudha for a discussion instead
